前提非相対論・無限質量の点核。核電荷Z=1,2。縮約動径軌道を一様格子の2次中心差分で離散化。単位原子単位系：エネルギーhartree、距離bohr。境界・モデルの範囲孤立系、u(0)=u(r_max)=0。主計算r_max=60 bohr。H 1sの領域打切り依存は別に検査。 入力と実行 固定入力 / inputs.json 実行する場所：quantum-atoms-2026-11-21（ZIPを展開した中の配布版フォルダ） python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt python run.py --input inputs.json --reference reference-pyscf.json --output output --figures このコマンドは水素型原子とHeをまとめて計算します。水素型は核電荷・量子数を指定した1電子問題、Heは2電子・球対称1s²のSCF問題です。HeのHFと交換のみLDAは、電子相関を含む厳密なHeとは異なります。 テストと依存関係のファイルpython -m pytest -q core / requirements.txt testing / requirements-dev.txt Isolated one-electron H and He⁺: compare 1s, 2s, 2p and 3d energies and radial orbitals against analytic solutions. Not a direct many-electron or molecular solver. Equations, figures and error analysis · Code ZIP for this example AssumptionsNonrelativistic infinite-mass point nucleus, Z=1,2. Reduced radial orbitals use second-order central differences on a uniform mesh.UnitsAtomic units: energy in hartree, distance in bohr.Boundaries and model scopeIsolated boundaries, u(0)=u(r_max)=0. Main domain r_max=60 bohr; hydrogen 1s has a separate box-truncation study. Inputs and execution Fixed input / inputs.json Run from: quantum-atoms-2026-11-21 (the edition directory inside the extracted ZIP) python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt python run.py --input inputs.json --reference reference-pyscf.json --output output --figures This command computes both hydrogenic atoms and helium. Hydrogenic states are one-electron problems specified by charge and quantum numbers; helium is a two-electron spherical 1s² SCF problem. HF and exchange-only LDA are not exact correlated helium.
